The '''Battle of Yag'Dhul''' occurred in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] and was the first engagement between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Sander Delvardus]].<ref name="TEA" />

Delvardus tried to expand his territory and was able to claim the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] from [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] to [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]].<ref name="TEA" /> The New Republic, however, chose to stop Delvardus' ambitions for the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] and sent a fleet from the [[Moorja system/Legends|Moorja system]], [[Seizure of Moorja|liberated]] the [[4 ABY/Legends|previous year]]. The New Republic was victorious and Delvardus was forced to abandon the Rimma Trade Route and retreat in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TEA" />
